laws.rule: eThekwini municipal beaches, including Durban: alcohol consumption is prohibited except on licensed premises or where the municipality has granted temporary authorisation (Beaches By-law section 10).
eThekwini municipal beaches: do not swim where prohibited, at night, outside designated times, or where official lifeguards are absent (sections 6 and 10).

eThekwini municipal beaches: overnight sleeping or camping and tents for overnight stays are restricted to designated areas (section 13); section 10 also prohibits entering the beach area for the purpose of sleeping.
eThekwini municipal beaches: fires are prohibited except for a braai in an area where it is allowed, or where authorised by the municipality or law (section 10).

eThekwini municipal beaches: launching or landing a boat, surf-ski or other craft is limited to places set aside by the municipality unless otherwise authorised or required by law; surfing in a designated swimming area needs municipal authorisation (sections 8 and 9).
eThekwini municipal beaches: smoking or inhaling through a hubbly bubbly, tobacco water pipe or similar apparatus is prohibited (section 10).

eThekwini municipal beaches: animals are generally not allowed unless a displayed notice or written permission permits them; the by-law provides exceptions including guide dogs for people with visual impairment (section 11).

eThekwini municipal coastal area: do not damage plants, disturb nesting birds or take fish and other marine species without authorisation; fishing from piers, groynes or stormwater outfalls is allowed only where signed or otherwise permitted by law (sections 14 and 15).
eThekwini municipal beaches: nude sunbathing or bathing is prohibited; the clothing provision expressly excludes breastfeeding (section 10).
KwaZulu-Natal Liquor Licensing Act section 93 prohibits being intoxicated in a public place and prohibits being intoxicated on licensed premises.

KwaZulu-Natal Liquor Licensing Act section 93 prohibits introducing, possessing or consuming liquor on a publicly accessible sports ground that is not licensed, with an exception for licensed premises on that ground.

KwaZulu-Natal: eThekwini’s biodiversity guidance says collecting or trading listed protected and specially protected species can require permits under provincial conservation law; check the species and required permit with Ezemvelo KZN Wildlife before gathering or moving specimens.
